paragraphs: The V300d is the current top-spec diesel variant in the V-Class range, using the OM654 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine. This engine is part of Mercedes' modern modular diesel family and is shared across the wider commercial vehicle range, including the current Vito. The V300d shares its platform and 2025 refresh with the Vito, confirming genuine current demand and ongoing parts support.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every V300D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the V300D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the V-Class uses the OM654 engine family across its current range, engine matching and compatibility are straightforward but still critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic V-Class quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
